title: Fix NaN timestamp bypass in DAO backbone message validation
description: In receive_from_peer (line 651), the timestamp freshness check `age > DAO_TIMESTAMP_FRESHNESS_SECONDS || age < 0.0` is bypassed when age is NaN (from NaN current_time or message.timestamp). Add explicit NaN rejection: `if age.is_nan() || age > ... || age < 0.0`. This is a P1 security issue that could allow replay attacks.
close_reason: Fixed: Added explicit NaN rejection to timestamp freshness check (age.is_nan()), plus comprehensive test covering both NaN timestamp and NaN current_time
